from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
from pathlib import Path

from control.hengeltje.shadow_core import ImmutableRawArchive, QueueTracker, ShadowInvariantError, VirtualOrder

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROTOCOL = ROOT / "knowledge/candidates/protocols/MANUAL-SCOUT-HENGELTJES-20260924-shadow-v1.json"
CORE = ROOT / "control/hengeltje/shadow_core.py"


def order() -> VirtualOrder:
    return VirtualOrder("TEST-WEATHER", "NO", 89, 5, 10, "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z")


class HengeltjeShadowCoreTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_protocol_is_frozen_read_only(self):
        p = json.loads(PROTOCOL.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertTrue(p["point_in_time_evidence"]["immutable_raw_required"])
        self.assertTrue(p["activation_gate"]["activation_before_gate_pass_forbidden"])
        self.assertEqual(p["virtual_order_grid"]["maker_bid_cents"], [85, 87, 89, 91, 93])
        self.assertEqual(p["virtual_order_grid"]["t_minus_minutes"], [30, 20, 15, 10, 5])
        self.assertEqual(p["virtual_order_grid"]["size_contracts"], 5)
        for key in ("live_trading", "order_placement", "cancel_or_amend", "wallet_actions", "paid_actions", "openai_api", "cloud_or_vps"):
            self.assertFalse(p["safety"][key])

    def test_immutable_hash_archive(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            a = ImmutableRawArchive(Path(d))
            r1 = a.store_bytes(b"abc", source="fixture", received_at="2026-10-01T09:00:00Z", content_type="application/json")
            r2 = a.store_bytes(b"abc", source="fixture", received_at="2026-10-01T09:00:00Z", content_type="application/json")
            self.assertEqual(r1, r2)
            obj = Path(d) / "objects" / r1["sha256"][:2] / (r1["sha256"] + ".bin")
            self.assertEqual(obj.read_bytes(), b"abc")

    def test_touch_and_cancel_never_prove_fill(self):
        q = QueueTracker(order())
        q.snapshot(sequence=10, displayed_qty_at_price=7)
        q.event(sequence=11, touched=True)
        q.event(sequence=12, cancelled_qty=7)
        self.assertEqual(q.queue_ahead, 7)
        self.assertEqual(q.proven_fill, 0)

    def test_only_proven_execution_depletes_queue_and_partial_fill(self):
        q = QueueTracker(order())
        q.snapshot(sequence=20, displayed_qty_at_price=3)
        q.event(sequence=21, executed_qty=2)
        self.assertEqual((q.queue_ahead, q.proven_fill), (1, 0))
        q.event(sequence=22, executed_qty=3)
        self.assertEqual((q.queue_ahead, q.proven_fill), (0, 2))
        self.assertEqual(q.primary_filled_quantity(), 2)

    def test_sequence_gap_fails_closed(self):
        q = QueueTracker(order())
        q.snapshot(sequence=30, displayed_qty_at_price=0)
        q.event(sequence=32, executed_qty=5)
        self.assertEqual(q.status, "UNPROVEN_FILL")
        self.assertEqual(q.primary_filled_quantity(), 0)

    def test_reconnect_and_restart_fail_closed(self):
        q = QueueTracker(order())
        q.snapshot(sequence=40, displayed_qty_at_price=0)
        q.reconnect()
        self.assertEqual(q.status, "UNPROVEN_FILL")
        r = QueueTracker(order())
        r.snapshot(sequence=50, displayed_qty_at_price=0)
        r.restart()
        self.assertEqual(r.status, "UNPROVEN_RESTART")

    def test_order_definition_is_immutable(self):
        o = order()
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            o.price_cents = 91

    def test_core_has_no_network_or_process_imports(self):
        tree = ast.parse(CORE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        blocked = {"socket", "urllib", "requests", "httpx", "websocket", "websockets", "subprocess"}
        imported = set()
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                imported.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
                imported.add(node.module.split(".")[0])
        self.assertFalse(imported & blocked, imported & blocked)

    def test_miami_regression_arithmetic(self):
        cost = 5 * 0.89
        payout = 5.0
        self.assertAlmostEqual(cost, 4.45, places=8)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(payout - cost, 0.55, places=8)
        self.assertAlmostEqual((payout - cost) / cost * 100, 12.35955056179775, places=8)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
